Package gov.cdc.izgateway.hub.security

Class ApiKeyAuditLogger

java.lang.Object
gov.cdc.izgateway.hub.security.ApiKeyAuditLogger
@Component public class ApiKeyAuditLogger extends Object
Emits structured audit events for API-key credential lifecycle actions.

Events are written as structured Logstash fields via Markers2 so they flow through Hub's existing JSON logging pipeline alongside the rest of the application's security logging. This is a dedicated, injectable component so the audit behaviour can be unit-tested independently of the code paths that trigger it.

Currently this emits the API_KEY_REVOKED and API_KEY_EXPIRED events used by the grace-period revocation job (IGDD-2711, IGDD-3167). Authentication audit events (API_KEY_USED / API_KEY_AUTH_FAILED) are introduced by IGDD-2704, wired into ApiKeyPrincipalProvider in that change.

  • Method Details

    • apiKeyRevoked

      public void apiKeyRevoked(String keyId, String jurisdictionId, String revokedBy, String supersededBy)
      Emit an API_KEY_REVOKED audit event for a credential revocation.

      Used by the grace-period revocation scheduled job (IGDD-2711) when a superseded credential is revoked after its grace period expires. The event carries no token or secret material.

      Parameters:
      keyId - the revoked API key identifier (JWT jti)
      jurisdictionId - the jurisdiction the credential belonged to
      revokedBy - the identity performing the revocation (e.g. SYSTEM_GRACE_REVOCATION)
      supersededBy - the jti of the renewed credential that superseded this one; may be null

    • apiKeyExpired

      public void apiKeyExpired(String keyId, String jurisdictionId, String expiredBy, String supersededBy)
      Emit an API_KEY_EXPIRED audit event for a credential that reached its own expiry.

      Used by the grace-period revocation scheduled job (IGDD-3167) when a superseded credential's own expiresAt was on or before its graceExpiresAt — the JWT exp capped its validity before the grace window would have. The event carries no token or secret material.

      Parameters:
      keyId - the expired API key identifier (JWT jti)
      jurisdictionId - the jurisdiction the credential belonged to
      expiredBy - the identity recording the expiry (e.g. SYSTEM_GRACE_EXPIRATION)
      supersededBy - the jti of the renewed credential that superseded this one; may be null
